title: Vaseegara
desc: Bhupathi's father sends him to live under the guidance of his best friend, Viswanath, and find a job. He gets close to the family and falls in love with Viswanath's daughter, who is already engaged.

title: Vedham Pudhithu
desc: Vaidehi belongs to an orthodox Brahmin family and falls in love with Sankarapandi who is from a different caste. Their love is disapproved by her father but is accepted by Sankarapandi's family.

title: Udhiri Pookkal
desc: Vadivelu is a sadist who never respects the feelings of his children and wife. When his plan to marry his wife's sister fails, he accuses his wife of having an affair with the health inspector.

title: Vasalil Oru Vennila
desc: Ammu, a little girl, runs away from her bungalow as her stepmother physically tortures her. However, the girl finds love and solace in the arms of Kamala, a milk vendor.

title: Subash
desc: Subhash, an unemployed young man, joins the army to be able to marry his lover. However, when he returns from his deployment, he is shocked to see his brother leading a corrupt life.
